title: First-Response Triage Framework for Sales/CS Feature Asks
creator: Liam Chen
description: Create a repeatable, low-friction first-response triage framework for Sales and Customer Success (CS) to capture, score, and surface enterprise non-bug feature requests. Goal: reduce back-and-forth, standardize minimum scoping for product/engineering review, and accelerate decisioning for Dedicated/Private customers. Framework must balance speed for sales momentum with sufficient detail to estimate implementation risk and customer value.
acceptance_criteria: 1) A one-page intake template in Drive (v1) that Sales/CS can complete in <10 minutes. 2) A scoring rubric that classifies requests into: Quick Win / Requires Design & Prod / Large Integration / Legal/Security Review. 3) Automated Linear creation from HubSpot form with required fields enforced. 4) Internal playbook doc with examples and decision matrix published in Confluence. 5) Pilot with 3 AE/CS reps completed and feedback integrated.
steps: Interview 6 senior AEs and 4 CS managers to capture current friction points (done: 2026-03-02)
Draft minimum intake template (fields below) and circulate to Sales/CS for 48h async feedback
Implement HubSpot -> Linear form mapping and required field enforcement (Eng dependency ENG-3421)
Create scoring rubric and automation rules (auto-tagging, priority suggestion)
Run 2-week pilot with 3 AEs/3 CS reps, collect metrics (time to triage, missing info rate)
Finalize playbook and roll out training session (30m) for GTM teams
intake_template_fields: Short problem statement and desired outcome (required)
Is this required for go-live or revenue retention? (yes/no)
Technical contact and sample data (if applicable)
scoring_rubric: Score = (Customer ARR Tier weight) + (Revenue Risk) + (Implementation Complexity) + (Strategic Alignment). Thresholds: 0-3 Quick Win (PM can triage without design), 4-7 Requires Scoped Discovery, 8+ Large Project / Needs Exec Approval. Complexity guidance: Quick Win < 3 engineer-days, Scoped Discovery 3-15 engineer-days, Large Project >15 engineer-days or requires infra/ops changes.
automation_notes: HubSpot form -> Zapier -> Linear API mapping implemented in stub (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/hubspot-intake/pull/9). Required fields enforced at form level; incomplete submissions trigger an automated follow-up email templated for CS. Tagging rules: if 'data sensitivity' contains 'PII' tag as 'security-review', if ARR tier = 'Enterprise' set priority P1 default.
tradeoffs_and_considerations: Speed vs. fidelity: forcing more fields reduces missing info but increases friction for AE — we prioritize 10-minute completion target.
Automated scoring reduces manual work but can misclassify novel platform needs; include manual override path and audit log.
Security-sensitive requests should short-circuit to Security/Legal review, adding latency but necessary for compliance.
Avoid bloated templates; keep initial rollout minimal and iterate based on pilot metrics.
examples: Example 1: Customer 'FinCo' (ARR: $1.2M) requests VPC-only deployment for regulated workloads -> Scoring: Enterprise(3)+High Revenue Risk(3)+High Complexity(3)=9 => Large Project: requires Private deployment track and legal review. Linked notes: drive.google.com/finco-vpc-spec

Example 2: Customer 'DocHero' requests minor console UI to expose token cost per session -> Scoring: Mid-market(1)+Retention(1)+Low Complexity(0)=2 => Quick Win. Assigned to PM backlog for <2 sprints. Linked PR: github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/418
pilot_metrics: Target: reduce avg initial response time from 72h -> 24h, reduce missing required-field rate from 54% -> <15%, and increase triage-to-decision conversion within 14 days to 60%. Will instrument via Linear reports and GTM feedback form (sheet link: drive.google.com/enterprise-intake-pilot-2026)
updates: 2026-03-02: Stakeholder interviews completed (AEs + CS managers). Key ask: minimize fields that require engineering knowledge.
2026-03-04: Initial intake template drafted and shared; feedback from Sales: add explicit 'go-live dependency' checkbox.
2026-03-07: HubSpot -> Zapier proof-of-concept built; ENG dependency identified (ENG-3421) to harden webhook and idempotency.
2026-03-10: Scoring rubric reviewed with PM Leads; request to clarify complexity buckets and include sample engineering estimates.
2026-03-12: Pilot cohort identified (3 AEs, 3 CS), training scheduled for 2026-03-16. Action: finalize intake form and automation mapping.
risks: Low adoption by AEs if perceived as added friction; mitigation: keep flow <10 minutes and provide canned email templates.
Mis-scoring of novel enterprise integrations causing scope creep; mitigation: require engineering discovery for scores >=4.
Security/legal delays for high-impact requests; mitigation: pre-emptive checklist and SLA commitments with Security team.
